row.title: Tenant repositories are created by the platform's own administration app (TENANT-REPO-2)
row.body: Evidence: tenant-repos.yml run 45659451015 failed with 'no credential could create ultrastable/replication-ledger' because ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN, LANE_PAT and the lane App are unbound. Decision: a fourth route with no stored credential. deploy/tenant-repo-token.mjs asks the site over GitHub OIDC (op tenant-repo), the site asks the tick at /host/tenant-repo, the tick creates the repository with the administration app and returns a one-hour code-app token for that one repository only while it has no commit. Tested by seed/worker/test/apprepos.test.js (11 pass). The live probe is the next tenant-repos.yml run creating ultrastable/replication-ledger. Also: doctrine/full-stack.json now reads Practical Solutions' back end at tenant-ps-core (agencies.json answered 200 in Workers logs), not tenant-ps-web/health (404).
